tools.name: check_dates
tools.description: For each date, tell whether it is a public holiday in the country (with its name and status), a weekend, and a business day, including make-up working days such as China's 调休. tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: List a country's public holidays for a year, or between from and to (and make-up working days, if any). With no year or range, lists the next 10 holidays from today in that country.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count business days between start and end (inclusive), or find the date that is N business days after start (add=N; negative N goes backward; start itself is not counted). Uses the country's weekend days, public holidays and make-up working days. For Japan, set year_end_closed to also skip 12/29-1/3

tools.name: find_long_weekends
tools.description: Find long weekends: 3+ consecutive days off made of weekends and public holidays in the country (e.g. Japan's Golden Week, China's National Day Golden Week). Give a year, or from (default today) to list upcoming ones.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_dates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
